about: Each row is one story beat, shown in HoloCure's dialogue box (hud_dialogueBox) with a portrait. Text is HoloCraft's own writing. Generates DialogLine.

columns.speaker: string; name on the box
columns.trigger: ref systems.hooks (the hook that shows it)

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Welcome to HoloCraft! The fans have gone feral. Pick an idol, survive the night, and keep your world safe until sunrise.

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Here they come! Your idol fights on her own. Scroll the hotbar to swap idols, right-click for her special.

rows.speaker: Smol Ame
rows.text: Hic! A smol detective has arrived to stomp on you!

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Smol Ame is down! Something huge is coming before dawn...

rows.speaker: Fubuzilla
rows.text: KONKONKON! Fubuzilla is here to flatten your builds!

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Stage clear! The sun is coming up. Rest, build and get ready: tomorrow night they come back stronger.

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Overtime at the Holo Office! The fandoms have taken over the floors. Keep the desks standing until morning.

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: The Halloween Castle doors are open... Something old is waking up in the halls tonight. Stay together!

rows.speaker: Shubangelion
rows.text: SHUBA SHUBA! Shubangelion is coming through the office!

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: Shubangelion is down! Watch the windows... something BIG is climbing up.

rows.speaker: Lunazilla
rows.text: Nanora~! Lunazilla stomps into the Holo Office!

rows.speaker: Smol Ame
rows.text: Trick or treat! Smol Ame in a pumpkin is here to stomp!

rows.speaker: A-chan
rows.text: The pumpkin cracked! But Bubba's growl is echoing from the cellar...

rows.speaker: Cursed Bubba
rows.text: A huge cursed Bubba bursts out of the dark! RUN!
